help.text:
**mm-bot-manager commands**

- `!create <username> --repo <url> --criticality <1|2|3> [--display-name "..."] [--description "..."]` — create a bot; approval is required when approvers are configured
- `!import <username> --repo <url> --criticality <1|2|3>` — request an existing bot import in DM; approval is mandatory
- `!list` — list bots you own
- `!info <username>` — show your bot's details and readable dates with a UTC offset
- `!update <username> [--username "..."] [--display-name "..."] [--description "..."] [--repo <url>] [--criticality <1|2|3>]` — change your bot; username, repository and criticality require approval in DM; a mixed command waits in full
- `!delete <username>` — disable a bot you own
- `!token create <username> [--description "..."]` — mint a token in DM; the message remains in history
- `!token list <username>` — list tracked active token IDs
- `!token revoke <token_id>` — revoke your token
- `!language [ru|en|auto]` — show or save your language in DM
- `!help` — show your available commands

Criticality: 1 critical, 2 important, 3 auxiliary. Repository and criticality are required. Commands and flags stay English.

images.help:
**Bot images (DM, owner only)**
`!icon set <username>` + one PNG/JPEG attachment — set the bot profile image.
`!icon reset <username>` — restore the default image.
`!avatar set/reset <username>` — aliases for the same operations.
Maximum: 5 MiB and 4096×4096. Images are centered and cropped to 512×512 PNG.
feedback.help: Feedback (DM only): `!feedback` — commands, `!feedback new <text>` — submit, `!feedback list [page]` — your tickets. Do not include tokens or passwords.
feedback.usage:
Feedback commands (DM only):
`!feedback new <text>`
`!feedback list [page]`
`!feedback status FB-104`
`!feedback show FB-104 [page]`
`!feedback reply FB-104 <text>`
`!feedback close FB-104 <reason>`
`!feedback reopen FB-104 <reason>`
Text: 1–3000 characters. Attachments are not supported. Every message is visible to the author and feedback handlers. Do not include tokens or passwords.
feedback.handler_help:
Feedback handler commands (DM only):
`!feedback queue [page]`
`!feedback take FB-104`
`!feedback reply FB-104 <text>`
`!feedback set-status FB-104 waiting <question>`
`!feedback set-status FB-104 resolved <solution>`
`!feedback close FB-104 <reason>`
Take the ticket before setting waiting/resolved. Replies are visible to the user; there are no internal notes.
